# Dunes Discovery Tourism

> Dunes Discovery Tourism is a licensed Destination Management Company (DMC) based in Dubai, UAE, specializing in premium Dubai Desert Safaris, self-drive 1000cc Can-Am & Polaris Dune Buggy rentals, Quad Biking ATV tours, City Sightseeing Tours, and luxury Dhow Cruises.

## Desert Safaris & Off-Road Adventures

- [Dune Buggy Rental Dubai](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/dune-buggy-rental-dubai): Self-drive 1000cc Can-Am Maverick X3 Turbo and Polaris RZR buggy rentals in Lahbab Red Dunes with full safety gear and rally guides.
- [Evening Desert Safari Dubai](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/evening-desert-safari-dubai): Premium Red Dunes desert safari with 4x4 dune bashing, camel riding, sandboarding, live entertainment shows, and 5-star BBQ dinner.
- [Morning Desert Safari Dubai](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/morning-desert-safari-dubai): Sunrise desert safari featuring red dunes bashing, sandboarding, camel rides, and Arabic coffee.
- [Overnight Desert Safari Dubai](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/overnight-desert-safari-dubai): Bedouin camp desert safari with sunset dune bashing, overnight camping in deluxe tents, stargazing, and fresh morning breakfast.
- [Desert Safari with Quad Biking](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/desert-safari-quad-biking-dubai): Combined desert safari with 30-60 minutes self-drive 250cc-400cc Quad Bike ATV rental.
- [All Desert & City Tours](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/tours): Complete commercial catalog of Dubai desert adventures, city sightseeing tours, and luxury dhow cruise experiences.

## City Tours & Cruise Experiences

- [Dubai City Tour](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/dubai-city-tour): Guided sightseeing tour covering Burj Khalifa, Dubai Marina, Atlantis The Palm, Souk Madinat, Dubai Frame, and traditional souks.
- [Abu Dhabi City Tour from Dubai](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/abu-dhabi-city-tour-from-dubai): Day trip to Abu Dhabi visiting Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Louvre Abu Dhabi, Qasr Al Watan, and Emirates Palace.
- [Dhow Cruise Dinner Dubai](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/dhow-cruise-catamaran-cruise-dinner-dubai): Luxury dinner cruise in Dubai Marina and Dubai Creek with 5-star international buffet and live Tanoura show.

## Travel Guides & Editorial Content

- [Dubai Travel & Safari Blog](https://dunesdiscoverytourism.com/blog): Comprehensive guides, safety tips, packing advice, and adventure comparisons for Dubai travelers.
